- Maximum reimbursement for clinic visits is NT$1,000 per day/visit [1].
- Reimbursement for outpatient/emergency treatment will not exceed NT$1,000/visit [2].

- The total payment of benefits shall not exceed NT$120,000 for hospitalization [1].
- The benefit payment will not exceed NTD120,000/hospitalization [2].

- Your one trip abroad must last less than 30 days [1].
- If you travel abroad for more than 30 days, your continuous residence status is interrupted, and the 6-month period recounts from your re-entry date [2].
- Taiwan for 6 months includes a single trip abroad of no more than 30 days, with the days abroad deducted from the residency period [3].

- For reimbursement, you need to submit the following documents to OIA:
    - Receipt
    - Medical certificate (obtained from the hospital/clinic)
    - Post office account book, passport, and ARC (only for first-time applicants)
    - Application form (available at OIA)
    - OIA will submit the documents to Cathay Insurance for processing the medical subsidy [2]
- Required documents for reimbursement include:
    - Original Hospital Receipt
    - Official Medical Certificate (from hospital) [4]
- For claiming medical insurance money, you must attach a diagnosis certificate and medical expense receipt (copies or facsimiles are acceptable, but must be stamped with the original medical institution's seal or another designated seal) [註 1]
- Other documents mentioned in relation to the Cathay Insurance claim include:
    - 僑生保險 (二) 醫療費用收據正本
    - 居留證影本
    - 護照影本
    - 郵局存摺影本
    - 國泰理賠申請書 [3]
    - 相驗屍體證明書 V
    - 除戶戶籍謄本 V
    - 受益人戶籍謄本 V V（註 3） V
    - 學籍資料(或入學資料影本)
    - (請蓋經辦人職章) V（註 4） V（註 4）
    - 保險費補助之身分證明 [5]

- This insurance strictly excludes outpatient clinic visits [1].
- Reimbursement for outpatient/emergency treatment will not exceed NTD 1,000/visit [2].

- For international degree students applying for a work permit, the maximum working hours are 20 hours per week except during summer and winter vacations [1].
- For overseas Chinese and foreign students, the maximum working hours per week is 20 hours, but this limit does not apply during summer and winter vacations [2].
- For foreign students applying for a work permit, the working hours are generally limited to a maximum of 20 hours per week except during summer and winter vacations [5].
- It takes about 1-2 weeks working days to review and issue the permit [1].

- For a work permit for international degree students, the required documents are:
    - Alien Resident Certificate (ARC) [1]
    - Passport [1]
    - Certificate of Enrollment [1]
    - Attachment: Approval document signed by the supervising professor (dated within the past three months) [1]
- For overseas Chinese students applying for a work permit, the required documents are:
    - Application form [4]
    - Copy of student ID (including the registration stamp of the school registration group or providing a certificate of enrollment) [4]
    - Copy of valid residence permit and copy of passport [4]
    - Original receipt of the review fee (NT$100 per case, payable via postal transfer to account 19058848 or via ATM) [4]

- If you obtained a work permit through the school during your studies, it will automatically become invalid after applying for graduation, suspension, or withdrawal. Please do not work illegally to avoid violating the law [1].
- If you are a student who applies for suspension, withdrawal, or graduation, and your work permit is still valid, you should return the work permit to the school guidance unit [4].
- If a work permit is obtained during a period of suspension, withdrawal, graduation, language study, or technical training, it loses its validity, and you must not work with that work permit, otherwise it violates the provisions of Article 43 of the Labor Service Act [4].

- Work Permit is valid for at most 1 year [1].
- For international students applying for a work permit from October 1 of the first semester to September 30 of the following year, their permit cannot be extended beyond September 30 of the next year, unless they provide a certificate of enrollment [1].
- For foreign students, overseas Chinese students, and Hong Kong/Macau students applying for a work permit, the permit period is at most 6 months, and working hours are at most 20 hours per week except during summer and winter vacations [4].
- You can find the Handbook to International Exchange Students at the following link: <https://drive.google.com/file/d/1tCqWv20slRtL58a543gv7tbQom00qRkO/view> [1]
- You can download the ARC Application Form (Multiple Purpose Application Form) from the Immigration Department website [2].
- The maximum monthly stipend for a Master's student is NTD$15,000 [1].

- For the NCU International Student Scholarship, undergraduates need a cumulative GPA of $\geq 60$ if they have passed ONE NCU Chinese course or provided a Chinese communication skills Certificate [1].
- For the NCU International Student Scholarship, undergraduates need a cumulative GPA of $\geq 70$ if they have the same requirements as above [2].
- A PhD student can receive the NCU scholarship for a maximum duration of 8 semesters (including the suspension period) [2].
- The application date for the NCU Scholarship for the Fall 2026 Semester starts from July 6th to July 20th, 12:00 PM, 2026 [1].

- You can apply for a full academic year transcript at:
    - Self-service Machine near to Zhi-Dao Lecture Hall (Across from the OIA) [2]
    - Office of Registrar, 3rd floor of the Teaching & Research Building [2]
- For the scholarship application, you must have a graduation certificate and transcript that have been verified by the Taiwan Embassy Office [5].

- Resident Visa holders should apply for ARC at the local service center of the National Immigration Agency within 15 days [1].
- Foreigners holding a resident visa or changing to a resident visa should go to the local immigration service center to apply for alien resident certificates within 15 days counted from the next day of arrival or the next day of receiving a resident visa in Taiwan [5].

- The late processing fee for manual course selection is NTD $100/course [1].
- A late processing fee of NT$100 per course applies to the Course Selection Calendar [2].

- The cost for the Health Examination is NTD 780 [1].
- Freshmen who are overseas Chinese students are required to pay TWD 600 for the New Students’ Insurance, but only for the first semester [5].

- Foreign students possessing National Health Insurance IC Cards should pay TWD 4,956; [3]
- National Health Insurance fee is NTD 4,956/semester [1]

- Your relatives need to apply for visas at Taiwanese embassies abroad in the first place [2].

- Mức hoàn trả tối đa cho mỗi lần khám tại phòng khám là NT$1,000 mỗi ngày/lần khám [1].
- Việc hoàn trả cho các lần điều trị ngoại trú/cấp cứu sẽ không vượt quá NT$1,000/lần khám [2].
- Tổng số tiền chi trả của lợi ích không được vượt quá NT$120,000 cho mỗi lần nằm viện [4].

- Trong sáu tháng liên tục cư trú, bạn được phép đi nước ngoài một lần, và chuyến đi đó phải kéo dài dưới 30 ngày [1].
- Một chuyến đi nước ngoài kéo dài hơn 30 ngày hoặc hơn hai lần, ngày đủ điều kiện của bạn sẽ được tính lại [1].
- Việc ở nước ngoài không quá 30 ngày được tính vào thời gian cư trú, và số ngày ở nước ngoài sẽ được trừ vào thời gian cư trú [5].

- Đối với sinh viên quốc tế xin giấy phép lao động, số giờ làm việc tối đa là 20 giờ mỗi tuần, ngoại trừ trong kỳ nghỉ hè và đông [1].
- Đối với sinh viên quốc tế, ngoài kỳ nghỉ hè và đông, số giờ làm việc tối đa là 20 giờ mỗi tuần [2].

- Việc xem xét và cấp giấy phép lao động mất khoảng 1-2 ngày làm việc [1]。
- Đối với việc xin cấp giấy phép lao động, quy trình có thể mất 7-10 ngày làm việc [4]。

- 您可以從以下連結下載 ARC 申請表單：
    - ARC Application Form (Multiple Purpose Application Form).pdf [2]
    - ARC Application Form (Multiple Purpose Application Form).pdf [4]
- Mức trợ cấp hàng tháng tối đa của Học bổng Sinh viên Quốc tế NCU dành cho học viên thạc sĩ là NTD$15,000 [1].

- Người nước ngoài có thị thực cư trú hoặc chuyển sang thị thực cư trú nên đến trung tâm dịch vụ nhập cư địa phương để nộp đơn xin chứng nhận thường trú trong vòng 15 ngày tính từ ngày đến hoặc ngày nhận thị thực thường trú tại Đài Loan [3].
- Phí xử lý trễ cho mỗi môn khi đăng ký môn học thủ công là NTD $100/course [1], [3].

- Phí National Health Insurance (NHI) mỗi học kỳ là NTD 4,956/semester [2].
- Đối với sinh viên quốc tế không đủ điều kiện tham gia National Health Insurance, họ phải trả NTD 3,000 để gia hạn bảo hiểm do Cathay Life Insurance cung cấp [5].

- Batas penggantian biaya maksimum untuk kunjungan klinik adalah NT$1,000 per hari/kunjungan [1].
- Penggantian untuk perawatan rawat jalan/darurat tidak akan melebihi NT$1,000/kunjungan [2].
- Batas penggantian biaya rawat inap maksimum adalah NTD 120,000/hospitalization [3].

- Selama enam bulan masa tunggu untuk mendaftar ke National Health Insurance (NHI), Anda diizinkan untuk bepergian ke luar negeri hanya sekali, dan perjalanan tersebut harus berlangsung kurang dari 30 hari [1].
- Jika Anda bepergian ke luar negeri lebih dari 30 hari atau lebih dari dua kali, tanggal kelayakan Anda akan dihitung ulang [1].
- Taiwan untuk 6 bulan mencakup: 6 bulan tinggal berkelanjutan, atau satu perjalanan ke luar negeri tidak lebih dari 30 hari, dengan hari di luar negeri dikurangkan dari periode tinggal [4].

- สำหรับนักศึกษาต่างชาติที่ขอใบอนุญาตทำงาน จะมีข้อจำกัดชั่วโมงทำงานสูงสุด 20 ชั่วโมงต่อสัปดาห์ ยกเว้นในช่วงปิดภาคฤดูร้อนและฤดูหนาว [2]
- สำหรับนักศึกษาต่างชาติที่ขอใบอนุญาตทำงานจากมหาวิทยาลัย จะมีข้อจำกัดชั่วโมงทำงานสูงสุด 20 ชั่วโมงต่อสัปดาห์ แต่ในช่วงปิดภาคฤดูร้อนและฤดูหนาว ชั่วโมงทำงานไม่ถูกจำกัด [2]
- Membutuhkan waktu sekitar 1-2 minggu hari kerja untuk meninjau dan menerbitkan izin kerja [2].

- 您可以從以下連結下載表格：http://www.immigration.gov.tw/
- 所需文件包括：
    - A- 一份申請書。
    - B- 護照（驗證後需歸還）。
    - C- 探親：正本與影本。
    - 1- 在過去 3 個月內發出的戶籍謄本，或外籍居民身份證明。
- 國外文件必須經我國駐外館處認證後才能在國內使用。
- 在台灣以外發出的文件必須翻譯成中文或英文，並由中華民國駐外館處、領事館或貿易館認證。
- 申請書上需要簽名欄位，包括申請人簽名、代理人/授權人士簽名、證號等。
- 照片要求：最近 6 個月內拍攝、4.5 公分且寬 3.5 公分的照片，脫帽、未戴有色眼鏡、五官清晰、不遮蓋。
- Tunjangan bulanan maksimum untuk Beasiswa Mahasiswa Internasional NCU untuk mahasiswa magister adalah NTD$15,000 [1].

- Bagi orang asing yang memegang visa residen atau yang akan mengubah ke visa residen, mereka harus pergi ke pusat layanan imigrasi setempat untuk mengajukan sertifikat penduduk (Alien Resident Certificate) dalam waktu 15 hari dihitung sejak hari berikutnya setelah kedatangan atau hari berikutnya setelah menerima visa residen di Taiwan [5].

- Biaya pemrosesan keterlambatan adalah NTD $100/mata kuliah [1].
- Biaya pemrosesan keterlambatan adalah NT$100 per kursus [2].

- Biaya National Health Insurance (NHI) per semester adalah NTD 4,956/semester untuk individu yang tidak memenuhi syarat untuk NHI [2].
- Biaya untuk kartu IC National Health Insurance untuk mahasiswa asing adalah TWD 4,956 [5].
- Informasi mengenai cara mahasiswa internasional mengajukan surat izin mengemudi (SIM) Taiwan tidak ditemukan dalam halaman OIA. Silakan hubungi ncuoia@ncu.edu.tw atau +886-3-425-4945.

- 門診費用先行墊支後提出理賠申請，每日新臺幣 1,000元為上限 [4]。
- 2026 Fall Degree Student Handbook 中，門診/緊急治療的費用補償不會超過每日新臺幣 1,000元 [5]。

- 國泰保險的病房費用保險金，每日最高限額新臺幣1,000元 [1]。
- 2026 Fall Degree Student Handbook 中，住院的理賠金額不會超過新臺幣120,000元 [5]。

- 在等待加入全民健保的六個月期間，您在臺可僅出境一次，且該次出境時間不得超過 30 天 [2]。
- 如果您出境超過 30 天或超過兩次，您的資格日期將會重新計算 [2]。

- 外國留學生、僑生及港澳生其工作時間除寒暑假外，每星期最長為20小時 [3]。
- 僑外生工作時間除寒暑假外，每星期最長為20小時 [1]。
- 僑外生工作時間除寒暑假外，每星期最長為20小時 [2]。

- 碩士班每人每月不超過新台幣 15,000 元為原則 [1]。
- 獎助學金總額度大學部每人每月不超過新台幣 9,000 元為原則 [1]。
- 獎助學金總額度，碩士班每人每月不超過新台幣 15,000 元為原則 [5]。

- 持居留簽證入境或於境內獲發居留簽證者，應於入境或取得居留簽證後 15 日內，至居留地服務站申辦居留證 [1]。
- 依移民法第22條第2項規定，外國人持居留簽證入國者，應於入國後之翌日起算30日內，申請外僑居留證 [4]。
- 持居留簽證入國後15日內應申辦外僑居留證 [5]。

- 僑生參加全民健康保險的費用計算方式如下：
    - 新臺幣4494元/6個月，含在學雜費內1次繳清 [2]。
    - 若有清寒證明，僑務委員會將補助健保費（新臺幣375元/月），補助後費用為新臺幣2244元/6個月 [2]。
    - 國泰人壽僑保效期期滿，尚未符合參加全民健保資格者，應自費參加國泰人壽醫療保險，一學期（六個月）新臺幣3,000元 [5]。
- 關於國際學生如何申請台灣的駕照，文中沒有提供相關資訊。

- 僑生請領工讀金及學習扶助金的相關規定如下：
    - 僑生所提供之海外財務證明或清寒證明可參酌前項第一款之情形 [1]。
    - 家長在臺定居，其上年度經核定之符合綜合所得稅免稅證明或稅捐單位證明其全戶年度所得清單影本可參酌前項第一款之情形 [1]。
    - 僑生請領工讀金及學習扶助金名額由本會每年視預算額度及各校僑生人數統籌分配，並由學校負責審查僑生工讀及學習扶助之申請 [1]。
    - 工讀時薪不得低於勞動部公告之基本工資時薪標準；依相關勞動法規所生之各項給付由各校負擔 [1]。
    - 各期學習扶助金以該期未請領其他同 [1]。
- 關於打工薪水應繳所得稅，相關資訊未在提供的篇章中找到，請聯繫 OIA：ncuoia@ncu.edu.tw, +886-3-425-4945。

- 舊生申請時間：每年 6 月 5 日前公告於國際事務處網站 [1]。
- 逕讀下一學位者及秋季班入學者，其第一學年第二學期之獎助學金於 2 月 1 日前提出申請 [1]。
- 寒暑假期間，若學生離開學校超過 15 日，該月份之獎助學金經指導教授或系主任同意，始得發放 [1, 2, 3, 4]。
- 大學部每人每月不超過新台幣 9,000 元為原則 [1, 2, 3, 4]。
